title: sure the arc shape of the cube lets it pop out easily with a slight twist
text:
sure the arc shape of the cube lets it pop out easily with a slight twist. didn't care for them, er, don't care for them. sure the arc shape of the cube lets it pop out easily with a slight twist, but the cubes are too small and melt too fast. as for the great stacking ability. its a detriment. if you fill these enough to get a decent cube, and stack them, they freeze together.

I would LOVE to have had 1 or 2 less rows and a full sized cube. don't bother with these trays, it's gimicky.

I bought a new 2-pack of regular plastic trays at the Big Box store...for $2.99 with a 20% off coupon.
